decisions.reason: As a close-to-core software launch in a growing, investing firm and already given its own page, it still looks like a low-cost strategic option whose market potential is not yet fully revealed after only one year.

Because this connectivity module builds on the established offer, likely has limited carrying cost, and supports the firm's shift toward integrated digital airport operations, it is worth keeping while demand uncertainty resolves.
Although adjacent to the core, the billing software extends the integrated software stack and there is no clear negative signal yet, so keeping the option open is preferable to abandoning it early.
Equipment monitoring fits strongly with the firm's installed-base expertise and service model, making it a strategically valuable and relatively inexpensive option to retain.
Resource management is close to the firm's established airport operations offering, and in a broad, expanding portfolio the product should be kept until more evidence on adoption becomes available.
A controller safety alert service matches the firm's safety-critical positioning and digital-service direction, so with uncertainty still high and no failure signal it should remain on the market.
